lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots distributed across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the longitudinal spot rows to form a coarse grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges running horizontally along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical luminance transition from light to dark.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density cluster of smaller diameter spots localized on the cranial region anterior to the gill slits.
